tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind all dashboard content.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, dialogs sitting on bg.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Table header rows, code blocks, hovered rows, sidebar rail.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, table row dividers, separators.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 against surface), split panes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-subtle.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table metadata, timestamps.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, axis ticks. Never for body copy.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Cobalt. Primary buttons, links, active nav item, focus ring, selected state. One per view.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background: selected row, active tab pill, info callouts.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brand-subtle (badges, callout titles).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy status dots, 'Deployed', 'Delivered', passing checks.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and callouts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending approvals, retries, near-limit usage. Also the approvals badge.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and the approval queue banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed deliveries, destructive buttons and confirm dialogs.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of error badges and destructive callouts.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the command palette.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button horizontal padding; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; top of setup screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, dropdowns, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, command palette.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatars, toggle switches.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, command palette, toasts. Cards use borders, not shadows.
